❤
MERI SABSE PYARI SEHARISH KIANI! 👑❤️🌸

Agar mujhe tumse mohabbat karne ki wajah batani ho na, toh main kahunga ke mujhe tumhari sirf ek baat nahi, tumhari poori personality pasand hai. Tumhara pyaar, tumhari shararatein, tumhari baatein, tumhara mujhe tang karna aur tumhara woh andaaz jo sirf tumhara hai. 🥹💋❤️

Meri jaan, tumhein pata hai main tumhare saath kya kya karna chahta hoon? 🙈💗

Main tumhare saath choti choti khushiyan celebrate karna chahta hoon. Tumhare saath long conversations karna chahta hoon. Tumhare saath apni favourite yaadein banana chahta hoon. Tumhein apni kamyabiyon ke baare mein batana chahta hoon aur tumhari kamyabiyon par tumse bhi zyada khush hona chahta hoon. 🫂🌸✨

Main chahta hoon ke ek din tum apne khuwab poore karti hui mere saamne khari ho aur main fakhar se kahun, “Ye meri jaan hai, aur mujhe is par bohat fakhar hai.” 🥹❤️🧿

Tum saath ho toh safar khoobsurat lagta hai, 🌍💗
Tumhari hansi se har din behtar lagta hai. 🥹🌸
Tumhare saath guzre har pal ko sambhal kar rakhna hai, 🫂❤️
Aur har naye din tumhein pehle se zyada samajhna hai. 💍🌹

Meri sweetheart, main chahta hoon ke tum mere saath hamesha apni asli personality ke saath reh sako. Tumhein har waqt perfect banne ki zaroorat mehsoos na ho. Tum khush ho toh hansna, udaas ho toh bata dena, naraz ho toh apni baat keh dena. Main chahta hoon ke hum dono ek doosre ko samajhne aur behtar banne mein madad karein. ❤️‍🩹🫂

Aur meri baby, ek din agar Allah ne hamare liye saath likha, toh main chahta hoon ke hum apna ghar pyaar, izzat, sukoon aur dher saari hasi se bhar dein. Ek doosre ki choti choti baaton ka khayal rakhein aur saath guzarte waqt ke saath apni mohabbat ko aur gehra banayein. 🏡💍❤️

TUM MERE LIYE SIRF EK KHOOBSURAT KHUWAB NAHI HO, MERI JAAN, TUM WOH INSAAN HO JISKE SAATH MAIN APNE KHUWABON KO HAQEEQAT BANTE DEKHNA CHAHTA HOON. 🥹❤️🫂

Meri cutie pie, meri jaan, meri babe, meri baby, meri sweetheart, meri shehzadi… tum hamesha khush raho, tumhare saare achhe khuwab poore hon aur tumhein zindagi mein woh saari khushiyan milen jin ki tum haqdar ho. Ameen. 🤲🏻🌸❤️

I LOVE YOU, MERI JAAN. AAJ BHI, AUR AGAR ALLAH NE SAATH LIKHA TOH AANE WALE HAR KAL MEIN BHI. 😭💋🫂💍❤️

— Raheel
